q: How do I calculate the emissions of a phosphating pretreatment line?
title: Phosphating line emissions
short: Add the fuel heating the degreasing and phosphating tanks, LPG at 2.98 kg CO2 per kilogram or PNG at 2.05 per scm, and the pump and conveyor electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Divide by square metres or tonnes treated.
audience: Sheet metal, auto component and appliance makers

ul: Effluent treatment for the rinse water.

p: Some chemical suppliers offer degreasers and phosphates that work at lower bath temperatures. Meter tank fuel before and after any change, over similar output.
Bought chemicals and sludge disposal sit in Scope 3. Keep the invoices and disposal receipts.

example.title: Worked example: one month (illustrative inputs)
lines: Tank burner LPG: 2,400 kg x 2.98 = 7,152 kg CO2
Pumps, blowers and conveyor: 9,000 kWh x 0.710 = 6,390 kg CO2
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use fuel invoices, a line sub-meter and the production register.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 records. A per-unit figure divides those by the output you enter, and purchased materials are added from supplier data on the Scope 3 trail, labelled by source.
